description: Implementation of the SurfaceMtl class for Metal rendering in ANGLE, including frame capture controls, surface initialization, drawable management, and rendering target handling.

classes.name: SurfaceMtl
classes.description: Manages Metal surface rendering, drawable textures, and frame capture for ANGLE on Apple platforms.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Metal surface, sets up the CAMetalLayer, and configures rendering parameters.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer object for rendering.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current for rendering, obtaining the next drawable.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the buffers, presenting the current drawable and preparing the next one.

methods.name: obtainNextDrawable
methods.description: Retrieves the next drawable from the CAMetalLayer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: ensureDepthStencilSizeCorrect
methods.description: Ensures depth and stencil textures match the drawable size.

methods.name: checkIfLayerResized
methods.description: Checks and updates the layer's drawable size if the layer has resized.
